name: MBN
recent: MYMBN 在 2026 年 11 月提出每两股送一凭单的免费凭单计划，公司在 11 月委任 Tan Win Sen 为执行董事，9 月有多名大股东申报不再是大股东，主席 Liw Chong Liong 也在 9 月间接减持。最新一季（2026 年 6 月止）营收环比回升，但仍录得净亏损。
notable: 委任 Tan Win Sen 为执行董事，2026 年 11 月 3 日生效。
主席 Liw Chong Liong 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日间接减持 43,200,000 股（11.192%）。
risks: 免费凭单计划若行使，可能带来股权摊薄。
主席 Liw Chong Liong 在 9 月间接减持 11.192% 股权。
最新一季仍录得净亏损 790,000 令吉。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月止季度营收为 7,804,000 令吉，环比增长 25.1%，但同比减少 35.0%；净亏损 790,000 令吉，净亏损率 10.1%，较上一季的 14.6% 收窄。

recent_en: MYMBN proposed a one-for-two bonus warrant issue and an ESOS in November 2026. It appointed Tan Win Sen as Executive Director in November, while several substantial shareholders ceased to be substantial shareholders in September and Chairman Liw Chong Liong disposed of indirect shares in September. The latest quarter (ended June 2026) saw revenue recover quarter-on-quarter but remained a net loss.
notable_en: Proposed a one-for-two bonus warrant issue and an ESOS.
Appointed Tan Win Sen as Executive Director effective 3 November 2026.
Chairman Liw Chong Liong disposed of 43,200,000 indirect shares (11.192%) on 1 September 2026.
risks_en: The bonus warrant issue may lead to dilution if exercised.
Chairman Liw Chong Liong disposed of 11.192% indirect stake in September.
The latest quarter remained a net loss of MYR 790,000.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was MYR 7,804,000, up 25.1% quarter-on-quarter but down 35.0% year-on-year; net loss was MYR 790,000 with a net margin of -10.1%, narrower than -14.6% in the previous quarter.
